title: FlexLine Repayment Payment Method by Line Use
content:
On FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit, the way the repayment payment of a line closed to new draws while a balance remains is figured follows how heavily the line is used.

## Terms

When the balance is more than 75% of the credit limit and 4 or more draws posted on the line in the last 12 months, the payment is one equal share of the amount repaid (that amount divided by the number of months) plus one month of interest on the whole amount at the monthly rate; when the balance is more than 75% of the credit limit and fewer than 4 draws posted in the last 12 months, the payment is the larger of the level payment and the current-cycle minimum (the minimum payment due less the amount past due); when the balance is 75% of the credit limit or less, the payment is the level payment that repays the amount over the number of months.

With the equal-share payment the balance is repaid before the term runs out.

*Meanings.* The balance and the amount repaid are the outstanding balance on the closing date, the amount past due included; the credit limit is the line's limit on that date. The monthly rate is the line's APR divided by 1200. The draws counted are the draw entries posted on the line, and the last 12 months are the entries dated after the same day of the month 12 months before the closing date. Whichever way applies, the figure is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

| Balance against the credit limit | Draws in the last 12 months | Payment |
|---|---|---|
| more than 75% | 4 or more | equal share plus one month of interest on the whole amount |
| more than 75% | fewer than 4 | larger of the level payment and the current-cycle minimum |
| 75% or less | any | level payment |

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

Amount repaid 9000.00 USD over 24 months at an APR of 24.00% (monthly rate 0.02):

- equal share: 9000.00 divided by 24 is 375.00, plus 9000.00 times 0.02, which is 180.00, gives 555.00 USD;
- level payment: 475.84 USD after rounding;
- with a minimum payment due of 520.00 USD of which 150.00 USD is past due, the current-cycle minimum is 370.00 USD, and the larger of 475.84 and 370.00 is 475.84 USD.

A balance of exactly 75% of the limit is "75% or less"; with 4 draws in the window the count is "4 or more".
